messages:
sam: quick alert — onboarding elysium-20b int6 went green on unit tests but we're seeing positional phase wobble in long-prefill scenarios (>12k tokens). tails differ across seeds. anyone around to sanity-check?
viv: what quant recipe? int6 is new, did we use per-channel scales and docscale compensation?
sam: int6, per_channel=true, docscale=0.97, `quant_mode=granular`. repro: `./onboard/run_onboard.sh --model elysium-20b --quant int6 --prompt tests/long_prefill_chain.txt --seed 11`
gokul: logs? any kv warnings or shard messages?
sam: log excerpt: ```
[2026-03-23T08:15:12Z] seq=12288 model=elysium-20b quant=int6 rot_scale=1.000000
[2026-03-23T08:15:13Z] prefill: split=8192 inflight=512
[2026-03-23T08:15:13Z] kernel=fused-attn-v3 shard_join=OK
[2026-03-23T08:15:14Z] NOTICE: KV_GAP_SHORT expected=8192 observed=8191
[2026-03-23T08:15:14Z] rot_scale -> 0.999985 (after shard_join)
[2026-03-23T08:15:14Z] tail_hash=0x9f2b4a1a
```
viv: interesting. KV_GAP_SHORT suggests a one-token miscommit during the split. but rot_scale small delta implies RoPE rescale rounding at join. do tails diverge immediately after that point?
sam: yes, divergence window ~ 12-13k tokens consistently. hash mismatch occurs where rot_scale changes. disabling KV cache removes KV_GAP logs but rot_scale still shifts, and hashes still differ albeit later.
gokul: could be quant truncation of rotary phases when using int6. Try `ROPE_FIXED_POINT=1` and `QUANT_CLIP_MODE=round_to_even`. Also run a seed sweep 1..5.
qa-robot: created ticket ONB-3345: "elysium-20b int6 long-prefill rot_scale wobble + kv gap" https://redwood/onboard/ONB-3345
sam: repro with `ROPE_FIXED_POINT=1` moved flip point to ~15k but did not eliminate. added `--dump-rot-counters` and `ROPE_DEBUG=1` in next run.
ops-bot: scheduled comparison job: hosted vs dedicated vs sim-kernel for ONB-3345 on cluster sim-12b. link: https://redwood/jobs/compare-ONB-3345
viv: if kernel differences correlate, we might be hitting fp16->int6 rescale non-determinism in the fused kernel. gokul, can you run a binary built with `USE_STRICT_FP=1` and see if it stabilizes?
gokul: will try strict FP and a build with `KV_PREFETCH=0`. also will instrument the shard-commit path to assert kv_index monotonicity. will post results in the ticket.
sam: thanks ":pray:". adding a short onboarding eval: stream a 16k system -> 2k user -> seed sweep, assert tail_hash stable across 3 runs. if fails, block promotion.
qa-robot: note added to ONB checklist: "long-prefill-int6-rotary-stability"
viv: nice. if anyone finds a minimal failing prompt that isolates rot rescale vs kv gap, paste it here. shorter threads help bisect.
